facts.text: The sensor-simulation realism question for heavy machines covers cameras, radar, lidar, ultrasonic and thermal sensors in rain, snow, fog, dust, mud, glare and darkness, including how that realism is proven.
facts.quote: How well today's methods can simulate cameras, radar, lidar, ultrasonic and thermal sensors on a heavy machine in rain, snow, fog, dust, mud, glare and darkness, and how that realism is proven.
